rules.title: Security deposit cap of one month's rent (AB 12)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, most landlords may charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished or unfurnished units. Small landlords may charge up to two months' rent if they own only two rental properties with no more than four units total and are natural persons, family trusts, or LLCs whose members are all natural persons.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (2 months for qualifying small landlords)
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.coverage_text: Furnished and unfurnished residential rental units; last month's rent counts as part of the deposit, first month's rent does not.
rules.exemptions: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC whose members are all natural persons, may charge up to two months' rent.
rules.interaction: State law applies in Berkeley; the Rent Board says it cannot determine whether a landlord may charge one or two months' rent.
rules.extraction_note: Source is a Berkeley Rent Board summary of state law, not the statute itself. Before July 1, 2024 the limit was two months (unfurnished) and three months (furnished). No enactment date given. The quoted span is a bulleted line on the page rather than a punctuated sentence.

rules.title: Photo documentation for security deposit deductions
rules.requirement: Landlords must photograph a unit after regaining possession and before repairs or cleaning they plan to deduct for, and give those photos to the tenant with the itemized statement. For tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025, landlords must also photograph the unit at or immediately before move-in.
rules.key_value: Move-out photos required from 2025-04-01; move-in photos for tenancies starting on or after 2025-07-01
rules.quoted_span: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies with security deposits; the move-in photo requirement applies to tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025.
rules.extraction_note: The page does not cite the statute or bill for the photo requirements. The move-in photo requirement has a separate effective date of 2025-07-01. Deposits must be returned within 21 days, and proof of completed repairs is required from 2025-01-01.

rules.title: Security deposit interest under Berkeley Rent Ordinance
rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on the security deposit at the end of each year. If the tenant moves out before year end, the landlord must pay a prorated amount.
rules.key_value: Annual interest on deposits, prorated on move-out
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.coverage_text: Units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.interaction: Adds to the state deposit rules; does not displace them.
rules.extraction_note: No section number, interest rate, or effective date is given on this page; it refers to a separate calculator page.
